description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract base class for testing persistence actors with snapshotting capabilities in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains setup configurations, assertions, mappings, and helper methods for testing persistence behavior, journal entries, snapshots, and related operations within the test suite.

classes.name: PersistenceActorTestBaseWithSnapshotting
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common setup, helper methods, and assertions for testing persistence actors with snapshotting in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: createNewDefaultTestConfig
methods.description: Creates a default configuration object for tests with predefined snapshot thresholds and activity check intervals.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes testing environment, including adapters, helpers, and command-to-event mappings based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: assertThingInSnapshot
methods.description: Asserts that the actual thing matches the expected snapshot, including the revision number.

methods.name: assertThingInJournal
methods.description: Asserts that the actual journal event matches the expected thing, using JSON attributes for comparison.

methods.name: assertThingInResponse
methods.description: Asserts that the retrieved thing matches the expected thing, including revision checks.

methods.name: assertSnapshotsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that there are no snapshots for the given ThingId.

methods.name: assertJournal
methods.description: Verifies that the journal for a given ThingId contains the expected sequence of events.

methods.name: toDeletedThing
methods.description: Creates a version of the given thing marked as deleted with a new revision.

methods.name: toEvent
methods.description: Converts a command and a template thing into a corresponding event, using registered mappings.

methods.name: assertSnapshots
methods.description: Checks that the snapshots for a particular ThingId match the provided list of expected snapshots.

methods.name: retryOnAssertionError
methods.description: Retries the provided runnable until assertion passes or timeout occurs, to handle eventual consistency.

methods.name: convertJournalEntryToEvent
methods.description: Converts a BSON journal entry to a ThingEvent and assigns the sequence number as revision.

methods.name: convertSnapshotDataToThing
methods.description: Converts BSON snapshot data into a Thing object, asserting its revision number.

methods.name: convertDomainIdToPersistenceId
methods.description: Creates the persistence ID string from an EntityId (domain ID).
